abilities.text: Conjure a dragon that appears at the target location before flying forward, dealing spirit damage and leaving a burning path in its trail.

abilities.name: Plot Armor
abilities.text: Grant an ally a barrier . While the barrier holds, they gain bonus weapon damage .
up: Affects up to 2 additional allies. Increases barrier scaling.

abilities.name: Captivating Read
abilities.text: Target an area with latent magic, applying slow . The magic detonates after a delay, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize .
up: +2m Radius On Hit: Reduce Spirit Resist by -18% for 6s

abilities.name: Rallying Charge
abilities.text: Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city , healing allies and dealing spirit damage to enemies. The strength of the heal and spirit damage is amplified as the knights travel further.

abilities.name: Call Bell
abilities.text: Throw out a call bell that deals spirit damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional spirit damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement slow . Can be shot to detonate early.

abilities.name: Doorway
abilities.text: Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration. The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.
up: Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors
+30m Cast Range. +40m Doorway Distance and scales with Spirit Power.

abilities.name: Luggage Cart
abilities.text: Send out a Luggage Cart that deals spirit damage and pulls enemy heroes along its path. Can be alt cast with to target friendly heroes instead.
up: +25m Cast Range +90 Damage on wall impact
-18s Cooldown and 1.25s stun on wall impact

abilities.name: Hotel Guest
abilities.text: Send the target's physical body to be a guest at the Baroness Hotel. The guest is to promptly make their way to the exit elevator, where they'll be sent back to their original position. A stay at the Baroness Hotel is paid for in spirit damage . Failure to check-out on time costs additional spirit damage .
up: +150 Damage +1.5s Stun on Failure to Check Out
Unstoppable while the Baroness is occupied. 15s Cooldown on Failure to Check Out.

abilities.name: Bashdown
abilities.text: Slam your bat into the ground, pulling enemies down and dealing melee damage . The slam creates a shockwave that deals spirit damage and applies knockup .
up: -3.0s Charge Time Now deals 50% Heavy Melee Damage

abilities.name: Rising Ram
abilities.text: Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy. Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.

abilities.name: Blasted
abilities.text: Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for 7.0s.
up: +1 Bashdown Charge on use and +7% Wrecked Bullet Amp
+50 Melee Bonus Health and increases spirit scaling

abilities.name: Chain Gang
abilities.text: Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy slow when they pull on the chain. After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal spirit damage . The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.
up: +5m Range +1.3s of Unstoppable Per Hero pulled in

abilities.name: Jar of Dead
abilities.text: Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead. Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal spirit damage to enemies. Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.
up: Collecting death heals 5 health per pickup

abilities.name: Grasping Hands
abilities.text: Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take spirit damage and receive immobilize . Alt-Cast rotates the orientation of the wall.

abilities.name: Essence Theft
abilities.text: Your weapon steals weapon damage and spirit resist over time, up to a maximum amount per target.
up: +1 Max Steal Targets All Summons now apply Essence Theft

abilities.name: Borrowed Decree
up: On Death: Deal +5% Current Health as Damage -0.3s Time To Spawn

abilities.name: Disengaging Sigil
abilities.text: Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.
up: Gain +25% Fire Rate and +25% Bullet Speed for 8s
On Player Hit: +1 stamina restored and resets Air Jump/Dash limit

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.text: Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, immobilizing and disarming them, preventing them from parrying , and reducing their Melee Resist . Press Ability 2 to select a target. Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.
up: Gain 75% Bullet, Spirit & Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for 13s

abilities.name: Flawless Advance
abilities.text: Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage . Press Ability 3 to re-cast.
up: -12s Cooldown. Gain +60% Bullet Resist during lunge
+65 Perfect Damage with improved Spirit scaling. Increased lunge speed & distance.

abilities.name: Itani Lo Sahn
abilities.text: Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage , dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies. While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage. Hold Ability 4 or to delay the cast.

abilities.name: Strix Salvo
abilities.text: Launch a salvo of spirit missiles that lodge into the ground along a line. The missiles explode after a delay or upon detecting an enemy, dealing spirit damage and marking the target. Shooting a marked enemy with a charged shot consumes a mark to deal bonus spirit damage and apply a fading slow . Hold and drag to select the angle.
up: +2 Missiles, Longer Range, and Improved Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Chimera Mk1
abilities.text: Hold Jump / mantle to fly, building up heat. When max heat is reached, your jetpack will begin to overheat. Overheating: After a short delay, dive to the ground. Upon impact, create an explosion that deals damage and launches you and nearby enemies. If no hero is hit, you stun yourself. Press Ability 2 to dive early. Cooling Down: After overheating, the jetpack cannot be used until it fully cools down. Slows affect you while airborne. You always explode on death.
up: On Hero Hit: Heal and take no self damage
On Hero Hit: -50% Cooldown and +120 Spirit Damage

abilities.name: Jettison Fuel
abilities.text: Spray fuel dealing weapon damage over time and shredding bullet resist , building up to a huge backblast that deals spirit damage and knocks you backwards. Vents the jetpack when dealing damage.
up: +60 Burst Damage On Backblast Hit: +18% Fire Rate for 7s
-10% Bullet Resist Shred On Backblast Hit: Apply a Mark

abilities.name: Close The Deal
abilities.text: Grab an enemy and give them a hands-on demonstration, flying high into the air before crashing back to the ground. You and the participant take spirit damage over time while falling and spirit damage upon impact. Damage is increased to enemies under 50% health.

abilities.name: Pillow Toss
abilities.text: Throw your trusty pillow inflicting spirit damage and heavy knockback . Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.

abilities.name: Tag Along
abilities.text: Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst heal based on missing health followed by lingering regeneration . Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal, once per ally. You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability. You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.
up: 35% Bonus Item Range, Duration, and Barrier Effectiveness while napping
+15% Spirit Power and +35 Spirit Power while napping and for 10s after napping Improved Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Lil Helpers
abilities.text: Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers. Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading move speed . Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team. Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.

abilities.name: Naptime
abilities.text: Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities. When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy spirit damage .
up: -1 Stamina On Wake and no Stamina Regen while sleeping
-55s cooldown Reduced damage and unstoppable while channeling

abilities.name: Slam Fire
abilities.text: Instantly reload your gun. You gain bonus fire rate and deal bonus weapon damage based on the target's health for a limited number of shots, but suffer from reduced accuracy. Deals bonus Weapon Damage against troopers and neutrals.
up: If you hit all shots, deal +7% current health as damage

abilities.name: Boot Kick
up: +80 Bonus Damage and kicked enemies deal -35% Damage for 5s

abilities.name: Entangling Bola
abilities.text: Throw a bola, dealing spirit damage , applying slow and preventing movement abilities or stamina.
up: +0.75s Debuff Duration. Bola ricochets to 2 additional targets

abilities.name: Lycan Curse
abilities.text: Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse. Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased max health , and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.
up: +4 m/s Move Speed and 200 Bonus Health
On Hero Kill: Refresh abilities and duration

abilities.name: Light Eater
abilities.text: Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal .

abilities.name: Dazzling Trick
abilities.text: Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.
up: +70 Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling
+0.75 Silence Duration and -20s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.

abilities.name: Radiant Daggers
abilities.text: Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area. Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

abilities.name: Shining Wonder
abilities.text: Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets. Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.

abilities.name: Scrap Grenade
abilities.text: Throw a grenade of scrap that detonates multiple times, dealing bullet damage and applying slow . The grenade can be meleed to knock it away.
up: Add an additional final Bigger Detonation

abilities.name: Rat Swarm
abilities.text: Call forth a swarm of rats that leap onto enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and reducing their bullet resist with every bite. The more rats are attached, the faster they will bite the target. Enemies can have multiple rats attached, but can shake off a rat early by performing a ground or air dash .
up: +8 Damage and -1% Bullet Resist per Bite

abilities.name: Royal Pestments
abilities.text: Adorn scrappy armor, gaining barrier based on your max health . As long as the armor holds, bullets have a chance to be deflected back towards the attacker. The barrier does not benefit from resists.
up: Reduce all damage to a max of 250 +10% Max Health as Barrier

abilities.name: Rule, Ratannia!
abilities.text: Charge up and summon the banner of Ratannia, granting all nearby allies increased move speed , immunity from slows , and reduced incoming damage while near the banner.

abilities.name: Setup Bishop
abilities.text: Create a bishop that remains in place indefinitely. Move ( ): Moves the bishop, applying a fading slow and dealing spirit damage to enemies it passes through. After a delay, activates diagonal squares that deal additional spirit damage when stepped on. Re-activate to recall all bishops, ending the ability.
up: +1 Square Range Impacts reduce Spirit Resist by -5%, stacking 5 times

abilities.name: Kingside Knight
abilities.text: Promote an ally to be a knight , granting bonus stamina and barrier for a duration. If self-cast you develop yourself as king instead, granting double the barrier but no stamina. Move ( ): Moves the piece, making it invulnerable during the duration before landing. If self-cast, re-activate the ability to move instead.
up: Can target two allies within radius. On Self: Remove all debuffs after a move

abilities.name: Rook Battery
abilities.text: Release a pair of rooks that travel forward, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize . If the rooks hit a wall, they reflect back in the opposite direction. Re-Activate : Split the rooks perpendicularly.
up: On Hit: Reduce 25% Fire Rate for 5s
On Hit: 5% Current Health as Damage

abilities.name: Living Ink
up: On Empower: Gain +10% Fire Rate for 10s, stacking 5 times
+1s Cooldown Reduction Per Hit Improve scaling

abilities.name: Flow State
abilities.text: Drag a brush that continues to travel forward, leaving a trail that grants bonus slide distance for allies and a fading slow and spirit damage to enemies it passes through, increased the further it travels. Re-activate the ability to flick the brush forward, ending the ability early but dealing spirit damage in a larger area.
up: On Slide: Gain Damage Amp over time, up to 20% for 6s

abilities.name: Still Life
abilities.text: Choose a hero to be your subject , dealing spirit damage over time as long as you are looking at them. If the sketch is completed they take additional spirit damage , suffer from stun , and drop a sketch that can be picked up. For each collected sketch , you permanently gain stats based on the hero.
up: While Drawing: Gain 15 Health Regen, refreshed for 4s on pickup

abilities.name: Abstract Landscape
abilities.text: Create a circular display of ink that blocks vision and grants allies Spirit . Enemies inside are revealed, and leaving causes them to take spirit damage and suffer from Silence and slow , destroying the ink in the process.
up: On Buff: +25% Spirit Lifesteal +15 Spirit Power

abilities.name: Leech Therapy
abilities.text: Throw a jar of leeches that attach to enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and eating away at the duration of enemy buffs .
up: Leeches drain stamina and restore it to you on pickup
+1m Radius +0.3 Spirit Scaling +8 Max Leech Stacks

abilities.name: Wretched Vapors
abilities.text: Crack open a vial to release an ethereal vapor onto yourself or an ally that causes a rush, then a crash. Specter Rush: While it lasts, increases the speed of all actions and temporarily numbs all incoming damage creating looming specters. Specter Crash: When the vapors wear off, all actions are slower and any remaining specters deal their delayed damage plus extra damage . Incoming healing will prioritize removing specters first, preventing them from dealing damage.

abilities.name: Healing Needles
abilities.text: Load your weapon with a full clip of syringes that heal allies. Dealing damage recovers charges, and each leech you have collected slowly restores them. Reloading spends a charge for a fresh clip. Unused syringes are refunded as a partial charge. Recast to put them away.
up: +16 Heal Per Shot Shots restore 0.6 stamina
+0.4 Spirit Scaling Shots extend non-ultimate buff durations by 6%, up to their max duration

abilities.name: Lurking Terrors
abilities.text: Open your bag and reveal the horrors you carry inside, dealing spirit damage over time to enemies in front of you. Enemies looking at you build up terror and cannot use stamina or movement abilities . At max terror, they flee in fear away from you . Each leech you have collected adds fear duration . Enemies facing away from you take 50% damage unless feared.
up: -20% Move Speed and Fire Rate +30 DPS
+3.0s Channel Time +0.5 Spirit Scaling Takes 50% Reduced Damage while channeling

abilities.name: Threadsap
abilities.text: Weave a scraggly thread that follows your crosshair before bursting along its path, dealing spirit damage and stealing enemy Spirit , increased in effectiveness for Baba. While holding stolen Spirit , Baba deals bonus spirit damage with every bullet.

abilities.name: Granny Long Legs
abilities.text: Your bench's legs extend, granting bonus move speed , higher jumps, Debuff Resistance and Melee Resistance . Light Melee: Perform a kick that knocks enemies back. Heavy Melee: Perform a ground pound that applies knockup , slow , and deals spirit damage . Hold Crouch / slide to charge a high jump, release to jump.

abilities.name: Baba's Brew
abilities.text: Brew a pot of tea that applies a magical effect in an area when thrown, cycling over time in a random order between a soothing barrier , Silence , or scalding burn that deals spirit damage over time and reduces spirit resist . Press to pause or resume brewing.

abilities.name: Feed The Birds
abilities.text: Cover targets in front of you with bread , adding a stacking slow . When the channel ends a flock of pigeons bombard the targets, dealing spirit damage and hexing each target into a pigeon , increasing in both damage and duration based on bread count.
up: +125 Max Damage +125 Spirit Scaling +0.5s Max Duration

Cultist Sacrifice.name: Cultist Sacrifice
Cultist Sacrifice.text: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

Tesla Bullets.name: Tesla Bullets
Tesla Bullets.text: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

Capacitor.name: Capacitor
Capacitor.text: Launch a projectile that deals damage , applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities .

Hollow Point.name: Hollow Point
Hollow Point.text: When you are above 65% health , deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist .

Opening Rounds.name: Opening Rounds
Opening Rounds.text: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health .

Melee Lifesteal.name: Melee Lifesteal
Melee Lifesteal.text: Your next Melee attack heals you . This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

Rebuttal.name: Rebuttal
Rebuttal.text: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.text: Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items . On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit .

Weighted Shots.name: Weighted Shots
Weighted Shots.text: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

Close Quarters.name: Close Quarters
Close Quarters.text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.

Long Range.name: Long Range
Long Range.text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

Slowing Bullets.name: Slowing Bullets
Slowing Bullets.text: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

Inhibitor.name: Inhibitor
Inhibitor.text: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction .

Spirit Shredder.name: Spirit Shredder
Spirit Shredder.text: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

Heroic Aura.name: Heroic Aura
Heroic Aura.text: Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units. Provides move speed and fire rate to you and nearby allies. Minions get double value.

Silence Wave.name: Silence Wave
Silence Wave.text: Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage. Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.

Silencer.name: Silencer
Silencer.text: Your bullets build up to a Silence . Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires.

Berserker.name: Berserker
Berserker.text: Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.

Frenzy.name: Frenzy
Frenzy.text: While you are below 50% health , you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.

Siphon Bullets.name: Siphon Bullets
Siphon Bullets.text: Your bullets temporarily steal Max HP from enemies. Enemies regain their stolen health when the debuff expires.

Headshot Booster.name: Headshot Booster
Headshot Booster.text: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage .

Weakening Headshot.name: Weakening Headshot
Weakening Headshot.text: Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist .

Sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
Sharpshooter.text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

Headhunter.name: Headhunter
Headhunter.text: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage , heal you, and briefly grants bonus move speed .

Crippling Headshot.name: Crippling Headshot
Crippling Headshot.text: Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet, Spirit Resist, and Incoming Healing .

Mystic Shot.name: Mystic Shot
Mystic Shot.text: Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage .

Lucky Shot.name: Lucky Shot
Lucky Shot.text: Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit. Bonus damage cannot Crit.

Point Blank.name: Point Blank
Point Blank.text: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow .

Toxic Bullets.name: Toxic Bullets
Toxic Bullets.text: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also reduces Incoming Healing on the bleeding target.

Ricochet.name: Ricochet
Ricochet.text: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

Debuff Reducer.name: Debuff Reducer
Debuff Reducer.text: Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to you.

Dispel Magic.name: Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.text: Purge all non-ultimate negative effects currently applied to you. If any effects were removed, heal yourself and gain a move speed bonus . Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

Spirit Resilience.name: Spirit Resilience
Spirit Resilience.text: When below 50% health , gain additional Spirit Resist.

Bullet Resilience.name: Bullet Resilience
Bullet Resilience.text: When below 50% health , gain additional Bullet Resist .

Healing Booster.name: Healing Booster
Healing Booster.text: Increases the effectiveness of your healing .

Fortitude.name: Fortitude
Fortitude.text: After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen. When you are above 75% health , you have bonus Move Speed .

Leech.name: Leech
Leech.text: Reduces the effect of enemy applied healing reduction .

Trophy Collector.name: Trophy Collector
Trophy Collector.text: Whenever you score an assist or kill , gain extra sprint , ability range and passive soul generation . This effect stacks and persists through death.

Enduring Speed.name: Enduring Speed
Enduring Speed.text: Reduces the effect of enemy Move Speed penalties.

Stamina Mastery.name: Stamina Mastery
Stamina Mastery.text: Allows an additional use of Air Jump or Air Dash before landing.

Hunter's Aura.name: Hunter's Aura
Hunter's Aura.text: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate . If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled .

Grit.name: Grit
Grit.text: Gain a Barrier for a short duration.

Weapon Shielding.name: Weapon Shielding
Weapon Shielding.text: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

Spirit Shielding.name: Spirit Shielding
Spirit Shielding.text: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant spirit damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

Battle Vest.name: Battle Vest
Battle Vest.text: While you are above 65% health , gain weapon damage and bonus fire rate .

Enchanter's Emblem.name: Enchanter's Emblem
Enchanter's Emblem.text: While you are above 65% health , gain bonus Spirit and Cooldown Reduction .

Mystic Regeneration.name: Mystic Regeneration
Mystic Regeneration.text: Dealing spirit damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus regeneration . Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

Spiritual Overflow.name: Spiritual Overflow
Spiritual Overflow.text: Gain bonus Fire Rate , Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting heroes.

Return Fire.name: Return Fire
Return Fire.text: Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.

Greater Expansion.name: Greater Expansion
Greater Expansion.text: Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items.

Mystic Expansion.name: Mystic Expansion
Mystic Expansion.text: Imbue an ability to increase its range and effect radius .

Bullet Resist Shredder.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
Bullet Resist Shredder.text: Reduces Bullet Resist on enemies when you deal spirit damage .

Mystic Burst.name: Mystic Burst
Mystic Burst.text: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage , causing abilities dealing more than 80 damage to deal additional damage.

Tankbuster.name: Tankbuster
Tankbuster.text: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage , causing abilities dealing more than 165 damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.

Mystic Vulnerability.name: Mystic Vulnerability
Mystic Vulnerability.text: When an enemy takes spirit damage , they have their spirit resist reduced.

Healbane.name: Healbane
Healbane.text: Your spirit damage reduces the enemy's Incoming Healing . If an enemy hero dies under this effect, you receive a large heal.

Mystic Slow.name: Mystic Slow
Mystic Slow.text: When the target takes spirit damage , they have their Move Speed reduced.

Escalating Exposure.name: Escalating Exposure
Escalating Exposure.text: Dealing spirit damage applies a stacking Spirit Amp that increases your spirit damage to the target.

Compress Cooldown.name: Compress Cooldown
Compress Cooldown.text: Imbue an ability to reduce its Cooldown .

Superior Cooldown.name: Superior Cooldown
Superior Cooldown.text: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.

Transcendent Cooldown.name: Transcendent Cooldown
Transcendent Cooldown.text: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.

Slowing Hex.name: Slowing Hex
Slowing Hex.text: Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities . Increases the target's gravity. Does not affect target's stamina usage.

Spirit Sap.name: Spirit Sap
Spirit Sap.text: Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power .

Focus Lens.name: Focus Lens
Focus Lens.text: Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.

Rusted Barrel.name: Rusted Barrel
Rusted Barrel.text: Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance .

Disarming Hex.name: Disarming Hex
Disarming Hex.text: Disarms enemy target and reduces their Bullet Resist .

Rescue Beam.name: Rescue Beam
Rescue Beam.text: Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health . Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.

Decay.name: Decay
Decay.text: Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health. Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

Scourge.name: Scourge
Scourge.text: Apply Spirit Resist , Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced. Can be self cast.

Knockdown.name: Knockdown
Knockdown.text: Apply a Stun after 2s . Stun duration is increased against airborne targets. Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun.

Phantom Strike.name: Phantom Strike
Phantom Strike.text: Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage , Move speed reduction and Disarm .

Warp Stone.name: Warp Stone
Warp Stone.text: Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist .

Vortex Web.name: Vortex Web
Vortex Web.text: Throw a vacuum grenade, pulling all enemies into a small area and applying Slowing Hex . Alt Cast to Target Unit Directly.

Refresher.name: Refresher
Refresher.text: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges .

Echo Shard.name: Echo Shard
Echo Shard.text: Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability. This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability .

Torment Pulse.name: Torment Pulse
Torment Pulse.text: Periodically deals spirit damage to the closest two enemies nearby.

Shadow Weave.name: Shadow Weave
Shadow Weave.text: Become Stealthed . Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed. Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush , temporarily granting you bonus Weapon Damage and Spirit Power .

Majestic Leap.name: Majestic Leap
Majestic Leap.text: Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier . While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster. Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.

Restorative Locket.name: Restorative Locket
Restorative Locket.text: When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack . Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.

Healing Rite.name: Healing Rite
Healing Rite.text: Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.

Infuser.name: Infuser
Infuser.text: Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power .

Guardian Ward.name: Guardian Ward
Guardian Ward.text: Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed . Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

Divine Barrier.name: Divine Barrier
Divine Barrier.text: Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed . Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

Alchemical Fire.name: Alchemical Fire
Alchemical Fire.text: Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing spirit damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist . 50% less effective vs non-heroes.

Blood Tribute.name: Blood Tribute
Blood Tribute.text: Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve fire rate , Debuff Resistance and Move Speed .

Fleetfoot.name: Fleetfoot
Fleetfoot.text: Gain bonus Move Speed and Slow Resistance . Removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting.

Kinetic Dash.name: Kinetic Dash
Kinetic Dash.text: When you Dash-Jump you gain Fire Rate and bonus Ammo until your next reload. Lasts up to 7s.

Arcane Surge.name: Arcane Surge
Arcane Surge.text: After you Dash-Jump , the next ability you use within 7s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power .

Unstoppable.name: Unstoppable
Unstoppable.text: Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm . Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept .

Colossus.name: Colossus
Colossus.text: Grow larger in size , gaining bullet resist , spirit resist , and melee damage . Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed .

Cold Front.name: Cold Front
Cold Front.text: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage and Slows targets it hits.

Arctic Blast.name: Arctic Blast
Arctic Blast.text: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage , Freezing and then Slowing targets it hits. Slowed targets have their stamina regen frozen

Ethereal Shift.name: Ethereal Shift
Ethereal Shift.text: Instantly enter a void state and become Invulnerable for a short duration.

Cursed Relic.name: Cursed Relic
Cursed Relic.text: Curses an enemy - interrupting, Silencing, Disarming , and preventing item usage . Removes all non-ultimate buffs . Your own Damage Output is reduced for the duration.

Duration Extender.name: Duration Extender
Duration Extender.text: Imbue an ability to increase its Duration .

Superior Duration.name: Superior Duration
Superior Duration.text: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

Glass Cannon.name: Glass Cannon
Glass Cannon.text: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

Fury Trance.name: Fury Trance
Fury Trance.text: Grants Fire Rate , Spirit Resistance and Move Speed , and removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting, but Silences you and disables stamina usage and regeneration .

Vampiric Burst.name: Vampiric Burst
Vampiric Burst.text: Grants Lifesteal , Fire Rate , and Ammo . This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.

Lifestrike.name: Lifestrike
Lifestrike.text: Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount. This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

Spirit Strike.name: Spirit Strike
Spirit Strike.text: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra spirit damage with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist . Cooldown is 2x longer for Light Melee hits.

Spirit Snatch.name: Spirit Snatch
Spirit Snatch.text: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra spirit damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power . Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.

Melee Charge.name: Melee Charge
Melee Charge.text: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage .

Crushing Fists.name: Crushing Fists
Crushing Fists.text: Your melee damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks. If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned .

Diviner's Kevlar.name: Diviner's Kevlar
Diviner's Kevlar.text: Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power .

Radiant Regeneration.name: Radiant Regeneration
Radiant Regeneration.text: While in-combat, Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability.

Burst Fire.name: Burst Fire
Burst Fire.text: Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits a hero.

Surge of Power.name: Surge of Power
Surge of Power.text: Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power . When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.

Suppressor.name: Suppressor
Suppressor.text: When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate .

Quicksilver Reload.name: Quicksilver Reload
Quicksilver Reload.text: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage , bonus fire rate , and reloads bullets on use.

Mercurial Magnum.name: Mercurial Magnum
Mercurial Magnum.text: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage , bonus fire rate , and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power.

Intensifying Magazine.name: Intensifying Magazine
Intensifying Magazine.text: Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon.

Escalating Resilience.name: Escalating Resilience
Escalating Resilience.text: Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit a hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.

Veil Walker.name: Veil Walker
Veil Walker.text: Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth , Heal and increased Move Speed .

Reactive Barrier.name: Reactive Barrier
Reactive Barrier.text: Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced .

Restorative Shot.name: Restorative Shot
Restorative Shot.text: Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

Split Shot.name: Split Shot
Split Shot.text: Make your weapon fire multishot . Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus . Targets can only be hit once per multishot.

Active Reload.name: Active Reload
Active Reload.text: While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate , Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed .

Magic Carpet.name: Magic Carpet
Magic Carpet.text: Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet. Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.

Spirit Burn.name: Spirit Burn
Spirit Burn.text: Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing. The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.

Lightning Scroll.name: Lightning Scroll
Lightning Scroll.text: Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay.

Witchmail.name: Witchmail
Witchmail.text: Taking heavy hits of spirit damage from an enemy reduces a random ability cooldown .

Healing Tempo.name: Healing Tempo
Healing Tempo.text: Applying heal to yourself or an ally grants the target bonus fire rate and bonus move speed . Does not apply on innate Regen or passive Bullet/Spirit Lifesteals.

Armor Piercer.name: Armor Piercer
Armor Piercer.text: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance .

Plated Armor.name: Plated Armor
Plated Armor.text: Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all weapon damage or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.

Spellbreaker.name: Spellbreaker
Spellbreaker.text: The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.

Spellslinger.name: Spellslinger
Spellslinger.text: While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed. Each stack refreshes the duration.

Stalker.name: Stalker
Stalker.text: Dealing weapon damage at close range opens a wound and grants you bonus move speed . Wounded enemies take spirit damage over time , have reduced bullet resist , and are revealed through walls .

Express Shot.name: Express Shot
Express Shot.text: Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.

Ballistic Enchantment.name: Ballistic Enchantment
Ballistic Enchantment.text: Imbue an ability with increased range . Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit . Has reduced effect on non-heroes.

Recharging Rush.name: Recharging Rush
Recharging Rush.text: Dealing significant weapon damage replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities .

Golden Goose Egg.name: Golden Goose Egg
Golden Goose Egg.text: Gain souls over time , as long as you are alive. Hatch the egg, gaining souls and permanent buffs . The value of the egg grows the longer you hold onto it. Gain a permanent buff per 80 Souls accrued when hatched.
